items.definition:
act of leaving
Our departure time is 10:00 AM.

the ability to form new ideas or images in the mind

a flash of light in the sky during a storm

the reason or reasons for acting or behaving in a particular way
His motivation to succeed was very strong.

a set of clothes worn together
She wore a beautiful outfit to the wedding.

an official document giving authorization

a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person

an unexpected turn or development

curve, segment

maker, inventor

investigator

one who holds; container

covering; part of a car; neighborhood

absurd or meaningless words or ideas

a series of games to decide a championship

a person who writes poems

a yellowish-brown alloy of copper and tin

goods carried on a ship, aircraft, or vehicle

the Christian religion

a state of not understanding

a person who buys and sells

the quality of being amusing

a bad dream

a plant whose leaves are used for smoking
